exhalable.definition: a. Capable of being exhaled or evaporated.

plural of exhalation
n. the act of expelling air from the lungs

[医] 呼出

exhale.definition:
v. expel air

v expel air
v give out (breath or an odor)

v give out (breath or an odor)

v. use up the whole supply of

a. capable of being used up
s. capable of being used up; capable of being exhausted

exhausts.definition:

v. show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill

n. 显示, 显现, 展览品, 陈列品, 展览

exhibited.definition:
v show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill

n. One who exhibits; one who presents a petition, charge or

exhibiting.definition:
v show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
v to show, make visible or apparent
v give an exhibition of to an interested audience
v walk ostentatiously

n. the act of exhibiting

n. 表现, 展览会, 展览品

n. extravagant and conspicuous behavior intended to attract attention to yourself

n. someone with a compulsive desire to expose the genitals

裸露(或露阴)癖的

exhibitionists.definition:
plural of exhibitionist
n. someone with a compulsive desire to expose the genitals
n. someone who deliberately behaves in such a way as to attract attention
exhibitionists.translation:
(exhibitionist 的复数) n. 倾向自我宣传的人, 裸露症患者

exhorters.definition:
